provenance.limitations: Four historical museum coats in one slot. This measures cross-view instance matching, not semantic generalization, street-photo robustness, or outfit quality. Query and index are separate photographs but can share a studio setup and photographer. Interpret Hit@1 and per-query ranks; the default retriever returns only two outerwear candidates, so Hit@3 effectively measures Hit@2 and MRR@3 only sees those two ranks.
